historical_reviews.v3_1: Rear-rotor health is an independent redundancy signal. Each `_R` resource must be paired to the same lower FRU's `_F` sensor and evaluated under one control/load capture window without letting front RPM substitute for rear RPM.

original_test_intent: Verify the rear-rotor telemetry of LOWER_FAN1 through LOWER_FAN5 across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with every `_R` sensor mapped to its lower-bank dual-rotor FRU and assessed under the approved rear and front-rear relationship rules.
original_method: Map the lower FRUs and F/R tachometer pairs, capture PWM/control and lower-zone thermal/load state, prove same-target identity, collect complete standard command views and five protected rear Web rows in a bounded interval, correlate paired rotors, and exclude upper/PSU/front-only evidence, log clearing and fan mutation.
manual_activity: A thermal/platform reviewer approves the lower F/R pair map and rear-rotor tolerance, then confirms five protected rear Web entries and any asymmetric-rotor disposition.

Approved rear RPM/status and pair tolerance
Reviewed private Script/raw contract only if required
safety_requirements: Do not change PWM, mode, curves or thresholds
Keep rear proof distinct from front/upper/PSU telemetry
Capture paired rotors in one bounded interval

Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists

Pair rear sensors to FRUs/front mates

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek offers no runnable command and assumes a raw path is essential, but standard read-only lists are explicitly required by the source. An OEM request must remain unused unless its exact read-only contract is approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete standard IB/OOB lists and five exact lower-rear Web entries; pair every rear reading to its lower FRU/front mate and capture context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five lower-rear resources and five interfaces remain; broad grep, generic clear, front substitution and guessed raw access are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build five lower-FRU rows containing F/R identities, control/PWM/load context, all five rear timestamped values, contemporaneous front values and the approved rear/pair result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit redundancy-pair semantics and lower-zone context while retaining safe high-level reads.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Continued front-rotor operation can conceal a stopped rear rotor, especially when broad fan output is treated as a single health set.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Designed F/R speed offsets may vary with fan model and policy; no generic equality rule may replace the platform SPEC.

project_override_considerations: Define lower dual-rotor FRUs, `_R` mapping, paired-front relationship, control/load state and RPM/status limits. Private/raw Script use must be separately pinned; lower-front evidence remains independent.
expected_evidence: Lower dual-rotor FRU and F/R tachometer map
Control/PWM/lower-zone load and approved rear/pair SPEC
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Five protected lower-rear Web rows and page context
No-fan/SDR/power mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Script and criteria consistently target lower-rear telemetry. Broad filtering, log clearing and the unsupported raw-only assumption are procedural defects, not a purpose conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Lower-rear topology, pair mapping, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if rear identities cannot be distinguished and paired after those inputs are obtained.

review_improvement: Makes the rear tachometer an independently proven redundancy element rather than a derivative of lower-front or generic fan health.
independent_technical_reasoning: A serial dual-rotor fan can preserve partial airflow after one rotor fails. Because the paired front sensor may remain nominal, only separately mapped rear telemetry captured under the same controller state can establish the rear redundancy path required by this case.
